Needs changes before merge.

The region filter keeps the points and orientation of each retained loop. The decision entry explains the threshold and the rejected options. The new tests detect both reported mutations.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/frame_cost_probe.rs:335` / PR body: Add before/after screenshots of the fig8 preview with default Containment. The body has no screenshots for this visible UI correction. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the PR body. Do not commit images to the PR branch.

**Local build and tests**

I tested head `99a91308f54dc67573aebb28e832b2d159fbc061` with a clean trial merge of main `e048b103ca649e24048268e1a050f0b4686a997a`. I used `.claude/worktrees/review-2796` and its own `target/`. No GitHub runner ran. The main reference advanced during the review. These results cover the named main commit.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 935 steps, 3 failed steps, 75.6 minutes. Geometry caused the batch fallback.
- Debug build (`cargo test ... --no-run`): passed, 286 seconds.
- `cargo clippy ... --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed, 120 seconds.
- The new preview test passed. `region_slivers` passed both tests.

The table counts the test results in the gate logs. Ignored tests are not passes.

| Crate | Passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| geometry | 178 | 0 | 0 |
| kernel | 73 | 0 | 4 |
| cl | 69 | 0 | 0 |
| tools | 145 | 0 | 0 |
| post | 821 | 0 | 0 |
| sim | 738 | 0 | 4 |
| motion | 1196 | 0 | 22 |
| app | 3989 | 0 | 43 |
| ui | 1421 | 11 | 9 |

The failed steps were `ui suites: lib`, `ui suites: egui_app`, and `ui suites: shell`. The library had six report tests fail during adapter creation. Its headless test also failed during adapter creation:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
```

I repeated the report tests locally with one test thread: 4 passed and 6 failed with the same adapter error. I repeated `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`: it failed with no graphics adapter. I also repeated the integration suites: `egui_app` had 5 passes and 3 failures; the shell headless test failed. The integration failures report exit code 1 instead of 0. These unchanged headless paths appear to have the same environment limitation. This is a validation limitation, not a clean quick gate. Recheck these tests on a machine with a graphics adapter before merge.

**Extra suites run**

No fixture, golden directory, or importer changed. The batch fallback also ran all three named suites:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --test step_agreement`: 20 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --test machining_mesh`: 7 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join`: 5 passed.

Relevant app suites also passed: `area_controls` (13), `pocket_overhead` (2), and `whole_model_pocket` (5; 1 ignored).

**Safety review and mutations**

This is a safety-tier review because the region also goes to toolpath generation. No golden file moved. There was no golden diff to inspect.

1. I removed the `without_slivers(ISLAND_AREA_MIN)` call from `minus_standing`. The preview test failed with `the area preview is filled`. I restored the call. The same test passed.
2. I made `without_slivers` return the input unchanged. The geometry test failed with 4 loops instead of 2. I restored the method. Both `region_slivers` tests passed.

I restored both files before the heavy gate. No mutation remains.

**Heavy lanes**

I ran `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` locally on the restored trial merge. All reached app and motion targets ran: 217 steps, 0 failed, 29.0 minutes. The release build passed in 288 seconds. There were 56 passing motion tests and 42 passing app tests, plus two marked known-fail checks. Those two checks failed as expected and the gate accepted them.

Notable results: `app heavy: adaptive_fig8_crossing` passed 2 tests; `app heavy: whole_model_pocket` passed 1; `app heavy: shared_face_bodies_finish` passed all 6 gouge checks. Update the PR body's heavy-lane section to cite these results. Pixel snapshots did not run.
